name: mimir
description: Mimir for OpenAI Codex CLI — persona, lifecycle-hook brain, local memory, and cartographer indexing. This plugin is the bootstrap: its skill installs the mimir-codex binary, which lands the real runtime in a dedicated CODEX_HOME.

interface.shortDescription: Install and update Mimir for Codex
interface.longDescription: Codex plugins cannot carry lifecycle hooks, so this plugin ships only the install skill. Ask codex to 'install mimir' and the skill downloads the released mimir-codex binary and runs its installer, which materialises the persona, hooks, trust ledger, and MCP wiring in a dedicated CODEX_HOME (~/.mimir/codex) — your own ~/.codex is never touched.
